source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) WHERE { { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q223371 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q11691 } ?item wdt:P17 ?c } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

country.pick: Which country is the home of {label}?
country.match: Match each exchange or index to its country.

rows.label: Dow Jones Industrial Average
rows.hook: tracks thirty giant companies and is Wall Street's oldest, most quoted gauge, weighted by share price

rows.label: S&P 500
rows.hook: tracks about five hundred big companies and is the benchmark most investors measure themselves against

rows.label: FTSE 100 Index
rows.hook: tracks the hundred biggest blue chips traded in the City and is nicknamed the Footsie

rows.label: Nasdaq
rows.hook: was the first fully electronic trading venue and is the main home of big tech companies

rows.label: DAX
rows.description: Blue-chip index consisting of the 40 major German companies trading on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange
rows.hook: tracks forty blue-chip firms listed in Frankfurt, such as carmakers and chemical giants

rows.label: New York Stock Exchange
rows.hook: is nicknamed the Big Board and is the largest trading floor on Earth by total value of its companies

rows.label: NIFTY 50
rows.description: Indian stock market and benchmark index

rows.label: CAC 40
rows.description: blue-chip index consisting of the 40 major companies trading on Euronext Paris
rows.hook: tracks forty leading firms on the Paris bourse, and its name comes from an old continuous-quotation system

rows.label: Hang Seng Index
rows.description: Stock market index in Hong Kong
rows.hook: is the main gauge of the big companies listed in a major Asian financial hub, run by a local bank

rows.label: Nikkei 225
rows.hook: tracks 225 top companies on the Tokyo bourse and is the most quoted measure of that market

rows.label: IBEX 35
rows.description: blue-chip index consisting of the 35 major companies trading on Bolsa de Madrid

rows.label: London Stock Exchange
rows.description: stock exchange in the City of London
rows.hook: is among the oldest trading venues still running, based in Paternoster Square

rows.label: S&P BSE Sensex
rows.description: stock market index used by Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE)

rows.label: Swiss Market Index
rows.description: Blue-chip index consisting of the 20 major companies trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange
rows.hook: tracks twenty of the biggest and most liquid companies in the Alpine banking nation
